{{Quote|Nothing beats gizka, though, when it comes to being a true pest.|[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]|<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Gizka''' were small [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] that could be found all across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="Creatures of KOTOR">''{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORCreaturesFiraxa|text=Creatures of KOTOR 1: Firaxa and Gizka}}''</ref> on planets such as [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]]<ref name="KotOR" /> and [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Humansssss...taste like gizka.|Anonymous Trandoshan|<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
[[File:CreepyFaceGizka-WotC.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Gizka concept art]]
Whatever their native [[Planet/Legends|world]], their extraordinary [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]] rate led to a fair amount of gizka on many worlds, even including uncharted planets such as [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], finding their way from the wreckage of crashed [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It has been alternatively postulated that they came from that planet originally, spreading along with the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Their exponential population growth led to them being considered pests on almost as many worlds as they inhabited, as they commonly ate electrical wiring.<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="TSL" />

While they preferred grains and leaves, gizka could eat nearly anything, including wiring, insulation, and other components commonly found on starships. A gizka infestation was difficult to deal with since they could squeeze into impossibly small openings, allowing them to create warrens inside bulkheads or access tunnels.<ref name="Creatures of KOTOR" />

Gizka meat was nutritious and had a "universal flavor" that almost any creature could stomach<ref name="Creatures of KOTOR" /> and they were the source for the delicacy [[gizka steak]]. Some species of sentient carnivores, like [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], seemed to think that gizka were one of those kinds of animals that "everything tastes like."<ref name="TSL" />

All the attempts at domesticating the gizka ended in disaster since they always found ways to escape or chew on vital electronic parts while looking for food.<ref name="Creatures of KOTOR" />

==History==
The ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' once played host to a temporary colony of gizka, in an incident involving mishandled cargo, an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] shipping company.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"The Trouble with Gizka" is a play on the classic [[W:c:memoryalpha:Star Trek: The Original Series|Star Trek]] episode "[[W:c:memoryalpha:The Trouble with Tribbles (episode)|The Trouble with Tribbles]]," where [[W:c:memoryalpha:Tribble|Tribbles]] also have a very fast reproductive rate.

===Gameplay===
[[File:GIZKA.jpg|thumb|Gizka on board the ''Ebon Hawk'']]
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', the gizka can be eliminated on board the ''Ebon Hawk'' using a pellet called [[Gizka poison]]. This poison can be obtained from various traders, most notably the alien trader at the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] dock. Feed one gizka with the poison and it will attack and spread the lethal effect to its species-mates, and the "Trouble with Gizka" quest is complete.

Another way to get rid of the gizka is to pay [[Nubassa]] in the docking area on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] to help remove the gizka. A dark-sided character can force their way to getting him to take them for free, or to pay you for them. If the player is patient enough to wait until they arrive on the Unknown World, the gizka will leave the ship on their own, presumably due to the planet possessing a favorable environment for them.

A gizka can be found on [[Yavin Station]] even before they are on the player's ship. It can be killed for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points.

Revan can interact with the gizka on the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]''. If you chose to strangle them, they reproduce quickly.

In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' gizkas of different colours can be obtained by players as passive non-combat pets from various Cartel Market packs.
===Continuity issues===
In the ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', gizka are referred to as a "fish" which was prized by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] rather than a reptilian species. The species, according to the encyclopedia, is said to have possibly evolved from a more rabid native on Lehon about four millennia prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This time frame would place the evolution of the gizka about the time [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] encountered them during his travels. Additionally, the encyclopedia states that [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] was possibly the homeworld of the gizka. While the latter statement does not directly contradict canon, it canonizes the unknown origins of the species and the in-universe speculation.<ref name="CSWE" />

===Team Gizka===
The term "gizka" has been used outside the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe, as the animal became the mascot and namesake of Team Gizka, the organization responsible for [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords#Game mods|the Sith Lords Restoration Project]], a modding project for ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. It appears the team has indefinitely disbanded.
